answer.rationale: Federal OSHA requires effective information and training when a new chemical hazard that employees have not previously been trained about is introduced into their work area. Ordering a product alone does not establish that it is hazardous or that it presents a hazard not previously covered by employee training.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Determine from the product's hazard information whether it is a hazardous chemical and whether it introduces any chemical hazard on which the affected employees have not previously been trained.
